criteria.given: A workstream has untouched stock plan.md and review.md templates and no earlier substantive artifact
A workstream has a populated plan task row or a substantive review verdict
then: A populated task row advances the stage to planned
A substantive verdict advances the stage to reviewed

criteria.given: The agent has prepared or revised the intent and is about to ask for its required approval choice
then: The intent and generated workstream scaffold are committed on the dedicated branch before the question is presented
A requested revision is committed before another approval question is presented
criteria.review_only_reason: This is an agent workflow instruction; the appropriate evidence is direct inspection of the canonical stage contract and its generated runtime projection.
